description: Events annotated in the period for the property and globally: deploys, content changes, manual notes and Google algorithm updates (category "algo_update"). Use to correlate drops or gains with causes. Default: last 90 days. / Anotações e algo updates do período.

days.description: Window length in days (default 28). Ignored when startDate and endDate are both given. / Janela em dias.

endDate.description: End yyyy-mm-dd. Default: last synced date of the property (Search Console lags ~3 days; never "today"). Every response states the period used. / Fim; padrão = última data sincronizada.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id.
